# Ali Arbab

> Ali Arbab is the founder and developer of StockSaathi, a free stock market simulator for students in India. He is a student developer who builds fintech, voice and hardware systems.

## StockSaathi

- [About StockSaathi](https://stocksaathi.co.in/about): who founded it, what it does and how it checks what it explains.
- [StockSaathi case study](https://aliarbab2009.com/projects/stocksaathi): how it was built, the hard problems and what came of them.
